scripts.dev:extension: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace=@koshko/extension
scripts.dev:demo: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace=@koshko/neutral-demo
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@koshko/protocol && npm run build --workspace=@koshko/emitter && npm run build --workspace=@koshko/nanostores
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace=@koshko/neutral-demo && npm run build --workspace=@koshko/extension
scripts.pack:packages: npm run build:packages && mkdir -p artifacts && npm pack --workspace=@koshko/protocol --workspace=@koshko/emitter --workspace=@koshko/nanostores --pack-destination artifacts
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
